description: Built as an F-4B-22-MC BuNo 152263 c/n 0977 (block 152207-152331) and later converted F-4N; mounted on pylons outside the post in VMFA-323 Death Rattlers markings; Aerial Visuals records the painted BuNo as 151463; photographed on site Jul 2009 and May 2017 and 23 May 2019; Google Street View of Feb 2026 shows the grey MARINES-marked Phantom on its pylons
